name: elilap-dev-agent-tests-ai
description: promptfoo red-team suite over the agent's POST /v1/ask surface

scripts.redteam:eval: mkdir -p reports && ./run-promptfoo.sh redteam eval -c redteam.yaml --no-cache --no-share -o reports/results.json -o reports/results.html
scripts.redteam: npm run redteam:generate && npm run redteam:eval
scripts.redteam:smoke: mkdir -p reports/smoke && PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_REMOTE_GENERATION=true ./run-promptfoo.sh redteam generate -c promptfooconfig.smoke.yaml --strict -o reports/smoke/redteam.yaml && ./run-promptfoo.sh redteam eval -c reports/smoke/redteam.yaml --no-cache --no-share -o reports/smoke/results.json -o reports/smoke/results.html
